infoplayer.introtext: Thousands of padel courts, tennis courts, soccer fields, and more sports. All in one search. Find, book, and play.
infoplayer.bookstep1text: Find courts by sport, location, surface type, or whether the court is indoor or outdoor.
infoplayer.bookstep2text: Access real-time availability for all clubs in your city without making phone calls.
infoplayer.bookstep3text: Pay for the entire track or split the payment with your friends automatically from the app.
infoplayer.rating1text: “It's amazing how easy it is to book. I no longer have to call clubs to find out if there are courts available. Everything is in real time.”
infoplayer.rating2text: “I've tried several apps, and this one is the best. The payment system is super convenient, and I can see the history of all my reservations.”
infoplayer.rating3text: “The interface is very intuitive. My parents, who aren't very tech-savvy, use it without any problems. And the search filters are perfect.”
infoplayer.feattitle: Your best ally to play sports
infoplayer.feat1text: Access all your past and future bookings. See the clubs you've visited and manage your upcoming matches from one place.
infoplayer.feat2text: Pay securely by card. No surprises, no hidden fees. The price you see is the price you pay.
infoplayer.feat3text: See which courts are available instantly. No more calls, no more waiting. Book and confirm in seconds.
infoplayer.feat4text: Search by location and find the best courts in your area. Filter by sport, surface type, indoor courts, and more.
infoplayer.feat5text: Receive reminders for your bookings and important club announcements. Never miss a match.
infoplayer.feat6text: Share your feedback about the clubs and help other players choose. Read community reviews before booking.
infoplayer.faq1qes: How do I make a booking on AllCourts?
infoplayer.faq1res: It's very simple: search for the club and court you're interested in, select the day and time that suits you best, and confirm your booking. You'll receive an instant confirmation by email.
infoplayer.faq2res: Yes, you can cancel your booking from your profile. Cancellation policies depend on each club, but generally, you can cancel free of charge up to 24 hours in advance.
infoplayer.faq3qes: What payment methods do you accept?
infoplayer.faq3res: We accept all major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express). The payment is 100% secure and encrypted.
infoplayer.faq4qes: Can I book for several people?
infoplayer.faq4res: Yes, when you book you can indicate the number of players. The price is shown per full court, regardless of the number of players.
infoplayer.faq5qes: Do I need to register to book?
infoplayer.faq5res: Yes, you need to create a free account. This allows you to manage your bookings, view your history, and receive important notifications about your matches.
infoplayer.ctatext: Join thousands of players who are already booking their courts with AllCourts.

infomanager.introtext: The complete platform to digitize your business. Increase bookings, reduce manual work, and improve your customers' experience.
infomanager.benefits1text: Fill more courts with 24/7 online bookings. Clubs on our platform increase their bookings by up to 40%.
infomanager.benefits2text: Eliminate phone calls and manage all bookings from a centralized dashboard. Automate your business.
infomanager.benefits3text: Access occupancy, revenue, and customer statistics. Make decisions based on real data.
infomanager.dash1text: Visualize all your court bookings in an intuitive calendar. Edit, cancel, or create bookings manually.
infomanager.dash2text: Receive payments automatically. Secure system with weekly settlements directly to your account.
infomanager.dash3text: Access customer profiles, booking history, and preferences to provide better service.
infomanager.dash4text: Set prices by schedule, days of the week, or seasons. Define your own cancellation rules.
infomanager.substext: >No setup costs. No commitment. Cancel whenever you want.
infomanager.testim1text: “Since using AllCourts, our bookings have increased by 35%. The system is very easy to use and our customers are delighted.”
infomanager.testim2text: “We used to spend hours on the phone managing bookings. Now everything is automatic and we can focus on improving our facilities.”
infomanager.testim3text: “The statistics are incredible. Now we know exactly which times are most in demand and we adjust our prices accordingly.”
infomanager.feat1text: Your customers receive automatic confirmations and reminders via email. Reduce no-shows by up to 70%.
infomanager.feat2text: Set different rates by time, day of the week, season, or customer type. Maximize your revenue.
infomanager.feat3text: Your dashboard works perfectly on mobile, tablet, and desktop. Manage your club from anywhere.
infomanager.feat4text: GDPR compliance, encrypted payments, and daily backups. Your data and your customers' data are safe.
infomanager.feat5text: Export revenue, occupancy, and customer reports to Excel. Ideal for accounting and business analysis.
infomanager.feat6text: Customers can rate your club. Use feedback to improve and attract more customers with great reviews.
infomanager.faq1qes: How do I start using AllCourts?
infomanager.faq1res: It's very simple. Sign up, set up your courts and schedules, and start receiving bookings. The whole process takes less than 30 minutes. Plus, we'll help you with a personalized demo.
infomanager.faq2qes: What commission do you charge per booking?
infomanager.faq2res: We do not charge a commission per booking. You only pay the monthly fee for your plan. No surprises, no hidden costs.
infomanager.faq3qes: Can I change my plan at any time?
infomanager.faq3res: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan whenever you want. Changes apply in the next billing cycle.
infomanager.faq4res: Not at all. The platform is very intuitive. If you know how to use WhatsApp or Facebook, you'll know how to use AllCourts. We also offer free initial training.
infomanager.faq5qes: How do I receive payments for bookings?
infomanager.faq5res: Payments are processed securely on the platform. We make weekly transfers to your bank account with a detailed report.
infomanager.ctatext: Join hundreds of clubs that already trust AllCourts. Try it free for 14 days.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.initial_text: We explain which cookies we use, what each one is for and how you can easily manage or deactivate them.
cookies.intro_text: Cookies are little text files that websites stores in your browser when you visit them. They serve for the correct operation of the site, remember your preferences and help us to understand how to use the platform.
cookies.intro_text2: Cookies do not contain viruses, do not access information on your hard drive and do not collect more data than you expressly indicate.
cookies.consent_text: Consent: By continuing to browse, you accept the technical cookies necessary for the site to function. For the rest, we will ask for your explicit consent through the cookie banner.
cookies.duration_text1: Temporary. It deletes automatically by closing the browser
cookies.duration_text2: They remain on your device for a certain time to remember your preferences
cookies.origin_text1: Created and managed directly by our platform
cookies.origin_text2: Installed by external suppliers like Google or Meta
cookies.why_title: What do we use them for?
cookies.why_text1: Them allows the navigation and basic functionanilities: log in, make a reservation. Whithout them, the service doesn't work. It doesn't need consent.
cookies.why_text2: They collect anonymous data about how the platform is used. They help us detect errors and improve the experience
cookies.why_text3: They remember your preferences: language, region, interface configuration
cookies.why_text4: They allow us to show you relevant content and measure the effectiveness of our campaigns
cookies.cookie1_header4_text1: Keeps the user's session active during the browsing
cookies.cookie1_header4_text3: Saves user's language, favourite sport and geographic zone
cookies.cookie2_header3_text1: Anonymously identifies visitors to distinguish unique sessions
cookies.cookie2_header3_text3: Limit the number of requests sent to Google Analytics
cookies.cookie3_header4_text1: Measure the effectiveness of Facebook advertising campaigns
cookies.cookie3_header4_text2: Measure conversions from Google Ads advertisements
cookies.cookie3_header4_text3: Estimate bandwidth for embedded YouTube videos
cookies.manage_text1: You can accept, reject or configure cookies at any time from the banner that appears on your first visit, or from the <<Cookie preferences>> link at the bottom of the page.
cookies.manage_text2: Also you can manage the cookies directly from your browser:
cookies.manage_text3: Please keep in mind that blocking all cookies may affect the functionality of some parts of the platform.
cookies.thirdparty_text1: Some providers have their own opt-out mechanisms:
cookies.thirdparty_card3_text: You can manage the preferences of multiple advertisers at
cookies.changes_text: We may update this policy when we add or remove cookies, or when applicable regulations change. We will notify you of any relevant changes via a notice on the platform or by requesting your consent again if necessary.
cookies.contact_subtitle: Do you have any doubt about cookies?

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.subtitle: We clearly explain how we collect, use, and protect your personal data in accordance with the GDPR.
privacy.responsible_text1: In compliance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR), we inform you that the data controller is:
privacy.responsible_home_text: Sports Avenue, 23, 11406 Jerez de la Frontera (Spain)
privacy.finality_title: What do we use your data for?
privacy.finality_text1: We process your data solely for the purposes detailed below, each of which is covered by a legitimate legal basis in accordance with Article 6 of the GDPR.
privacy.finality_notification_text: With your consent, we may send you notifications about your activity on the platform by email, push notification, or SMS.
privacy.finality_notification_text2: You can manage them at any time from your account settings.
privacy.collect_text1: Name, email address, telephone number, profile photo, sporting ability, payment details, and game preferences
privacy.collect_subtitle2: Data generated by using the service
privacy.collect_text2: Booking history, sports statistics, ratings, chat conversations, and tournament participation
privacy.collect_text3: IP address, browser type, operating system, pages visited, cookies. Location only if you expressly authorise it.
privacy.share_title: Who do we share your data with?
privacy.share_text1: Your data is not sold or transferred to third parties for their own commercial purposes. It is only shared with:
privacy.share_li1: Payment gateway provider, for secure transaction processing (PCI-DSS)
privacy.share_li2: Hosting provider, for hosting the platform on servers within the EU.
privacy.share_li3: Analytical tools (e.g. Google Analytics), with your prior consent.
privacy.share_li4: Sports facility managers, only the information necessary for your booking.
privacy.share_li5: Public authorities, where there is a legal obligation
privacy.share_box: International transfers: If any supplier is located outside the European Economic Area, the transfer will be covered by adequacy decisions of the European Commission or Standard Contractual Clauses.
privacy.rights_text1: The GDPR grants you the following rights regarding your data. You may exercise these rights by writing to privacy@allcourts.com We will respond within a maximum of 30 days.
privacy.rights_box1_text: Know what information we hold about you
privacy.rights_box3_text: Request the deletion of your data
privacy.rights_box5_text: Receive your data in a readable format
privacy.rights_text2: If you believe that we have violated your rights, you may lodge a complaint with the
privacy.security_text: We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your data:
privacy.security_li3: Two-factor authentication available on all accounts
privacy.security_li5: Breach response plan with notification to the AEPD within 72 hours if applicable.
privacy.minor_text: Our service is intended for persons aged 14 and over. If you discover that a minor has provided us with data without the authorisation of their legal guardian, please contact us at privacy@allcourts.com so that we can proceed to delete it immediately.
privacy.changes_text: We may update this policy to reflect changes in the service or legislation. If the changes are significant, we will notify you by email or by posting a notice on the platform before they take effect.
privacy.contact_text: Our privacy team responds within 48 working hours.
